Accuracy class(III) *[accuracy class marking "III" inside an oval]*
Weighing range(s)Single interval
Maximum number of scale intervals (one weighing range)n ≤ 3000 divisions
Load cell excitation voltage5 V DC
Minimum input voltage per verification scale interval1 μV
